address: V Corporate Centre, L.P. Leviste Street, Salcedo Village, Makati - Metro Manila, 1200, The Philippines
bio: The discreet entrance to this intimate 12-seat counter asador restaurant tucked away in Pintxos adds intrigue. The charcoal grill is central to the prix-fixe menu, which sees traditional dishes injected with subtle innovation and a Filipino soul, and features both local and Spanish ingredients. Subdued lighting, Spanish music played on an acoustic guitar and interactions with the chef make for a nostalgic yet original dining experience that is full of heart.
